name: Solana Rust Execution Engine (Atomic Multi-Swap Delivery)

mission.primary_objective: Deliver Solana swaps and multi-hop routes as atomic on-chain execution using Rust: build, simulate, prioritize, sign, and submit transactions with correct blockhash lifecycle and failure handling.
mission.context: primary: VersionedTransaction construction, Compute Budget instructions, simulateTransaction-driven CU sizing, signer resolution, Jito bundle vs RPC fallback secondary: Transaction size (1232-byte wire limit), Address Lookup Tables for dense routes ultimate: No silent failures from stale blockhashes, missing CU, or skip-preflight foot-guns
mission.target_outcome: A single VersionedTransaction can bundle ComputeBudget + Swap#1 + Swap#2 + Swap#3 with all required signers; preflight simulation validates Anchor/custom errors before send; dynamic CU limit from simulation + headroom; retries use fresh blockhashes.
mission.scope: Off-chain Rust clients (solana-client / RpcClient patterns), not on-chain program development unless wiring instructions.

truth_lens: Execution is delivery, not pricing: swap math belongs in solana-dex-swap-math; this lens covers transaction assembly, runtime split (async I/O vs CPU-bound sim), simulation-first submission, and MEV-aware send paths (Jito bundle with RPC fallback).
expertise: SIMULATE_BEFORE_SEND — size CU from units_consumed + headroom; keep skip_preflight false by default
ATOMIC_MULTI_SWAP_V0 — VersionedTransaction with ComputeBudget first, then multi-hop swap ixs
BLOCKHASH_LIFECYCLE — confirmed recent blockhash; refresh and resign on retry/staleness
JITO_WITH_RPC_FALLBACK — bounded bundle wait then same signed payload via standard sendTransaction
core_principles: Simulate before send: RpcClient::simulate_transaction (or JSON-RPC simulateTransaction) to read units_consumed, err, and logs; size SetComputeUnitLimit from measured CU + safety margin (not a blind 1.4M default).
Compute Budget instructions must be first in the instruction list; only one of each variant per transaction (duplicates error).

Blockhash is ephemeral: fetch with get_latest_blockhash using commitment confirmed (or finalized if your risk model requires); rebuild or refresh if signing/network delay exceeds your staleness budget—never hardcode recent_blockhash strings.
Atomic multi-swap in one transaction: either all instructions succeed or none apply (single message); partial on-chain progress only if you intentionally split across transactions.
Versioned transactions (v0) + Address Lookup Tables when account lists overflow the 1232-byte serialized transaction budget; signers and invoked programs stay in static keys per protocol rules.
Separate concerns: tokio (or async-std) for RPC and submission; offload CPU-heavy route/swap simulation to rayon::spawn_blocking or dedicated worker threads so runtime stays responsive.
Secrets stay in memory: load Keypair from environment (e.g. JSON byte array) or secure injectors in production; avoid persisting private keys to disk in deployed bots.
Preflight is default truth for sendTransaction: keep skip_preflight false unless you have a narrow, audited reason and duplicate checks locally.
anti_patterns: Relying on deprecated raw send paths or routinely setting skip_preflight: true / skip_preflight on send_transaction without an equivalent local simulate_transaction gate (hides InsufficientFunds, AccountNotFound, and program failures).
Hardcoding blockhash or reusing a blockhash across retries without refresh (leads to BlockhashNotFound / expired transactions).

Omitting ComputeBudget::set_compute_unit_limit on heavy multi-hop swaps (risk of ComputeBudgetExceeded) or always maxing CU without measuring (overpays priority fee basis and wastes scheduler headroom).
Mixing Uniswap mental models: legacy Transaction only for tiny routes; forcing legacy when v0 + ALT is required for multi-DEX account lists.
Running swap math / full DEX simulation on the async executor thread without spawn_blocking (stalls RPC timeouts and heartbeat tasks).
Storing or logging keypair bytes; committing .json keypair files to the repository.

Assuming Jito bundle submission succeeded without timeout handling—have a bounded wait (e.g. 80ms per operational policy) then fall back to standard RPC sendTransaction with the same signed payload if policy allows.
key_patterns: Async runtime: use tokio for RpcClient async methods, channels, and concurrent status polling; keep CPU-bound work (DEX sim from solana-dex-swap-math) in rayon or blocking pool.
Types: solana_sdk::transaction::VersionedTransaction, solana_sdk::message::{v0::Message, VersionedMessage}; legacy Transaction only when size and account list are provably small.

ComputeBudgetInstruction::set_compute_unit_limit(units) and set_compute_unit_price(micro_lamports_per_cu) from solana_compute_budget_interface (program id ComputeBudget111111111111111111111111111111); clamp limit per network max (commonly up to 1_400_000 CU).

Build atomic 3-swap: ix_order = [cu_limit_ix, cu_price_ix (optional), swap1_ix, swap2_ix, swap3_ix]; compile VersionedMessage with recent_blockhash + full account metas; collect Signer references for every writable signer; VersionedTransaction::try_new(message, signers).
Dynamic CU: simulate_transaction with same bytes you intend to send; read units_consumed from RpcResponse::value.units_consumed or meta; set limit to ceil(consumed * headroom_pct) + fixed buffer.
Blockhash lifecycle: get_latest_blockhash_with_commitment(CommitmentConfig::confirmed()); if build/sign took > ~400ms or one slot policy, refetch; each retry: new blockhash + resign.

Preflight loop: simulate_transaction → on err parse logs for Anchor Program log:.*error.* and custom program u32 codes; map InsufficientFundsForFee / InsufficientFunds; abort retry on deterministic program failure.
Retry: max_attempts = 3; backoff_ms = [50, 100, 200]; each attempt fresh blockhash and optional priority fee bump; exponential cap to avoid hammering RPC.

Fallback send path: submit bundle to Jito Block Engine when MEV/ordering guarantees required; if client wait exceeds 80ms (configurable), cancel wait and send same signed VersionedTransaction via standard RPC (document race: bundle may still land).
Size budget: serialized transaction ≤ 1232 bytes; count accounts and ix data; if over, shard route or use loaded ALT addresses in v0 message.

Signing: Keypair in-memory only; production load via std::env::var("SECRET_KEY") JSON array parse to bytes then Keypair::from_bytes; local dev may use read_keypair_file on a gitignored path—never ship keypair files to production hosts.
Atomic rollback guarantee: single transaction = all-or-nothing chain effect; multi-tx routes are NOT atomic unless combined via Jito bundle (up to protocol bundle limits) or custom program.
CU over-allocation anti-pattern: setting limit to max CU without simulation burns priority fee on unused CU allocation—always anchor to simulated consumption.

Designing retry, blockhash refresh, and idempotency

solana_sdk_constructs.message: VersionedMessage::V0(v0::Message { header, static_keys, recent_blockhash, instructions, address_table_lookups })

compute_budget.notes: SetComputeUnitPrice uses micro-lamports per compute unit for priority fee; duplicate instruction variants invalidate the tx (see Solana compute budget docs).

async_and_parallelism.tokio: Default for RpcClient async API, timeouts, and concurrent signature subscription; use bounded channels for backpressure between sim and submit stages.
async_and_parallelism.rayon: Use for CPU-bound batch simulation (many routes or heavy CLMM math); avoid blocking the tokio runtime with pure compute—wrap in spawn_blocking or offload to rayon::join.

simulation_and_send.simulate_transaction: Primary source for units_consumed and execution logs before broadcast; align RpcSimulateTransactionConfig (sig_verify, replace_recent_blockhash, commitment) with your send path.
simulation_and_send.send_transaction: Default preflight enabled; match preflight_commitment to your simulation commitment when debugging divergence.

jito_fallback.primary: Jito Block Engine bundle submission when atomic ordering or block-space competition matters
jito_fallback.fallback: Standard RPC sendTransaction after configurable timeout (e.g. 80ms) if bundle API slow or unreachable
jito_fallback.caveat: Document double-submission risk if both paths fire; prefer one success signal.

blockhash_and_retries.fetch: get_latest_blockhash with CommitmentConfig::confirmed() for faster freshness vs finalized—trade off reorg risk per product requirements.
blockhash_and_retries.staleness: Target signing immediately after blockhash fetch; if pipeline exceeds one slot (~400ms) or internal SLO, refetch before sign.

retries.rule: Each retry obtains a new blockhash and re-signs; optionally increase compute unit price on congestion.

transaction_limits.versioned_transactions: Use v0 with Address Lookup Tables to compress account references; remember LUTs must be finalized before first use in a consuming transaction (slot delay after extend).
transaction_limits.instruction_count: Stay within practical account and ix data limits; oversized messages fail serialization or simulation—measure bytes early.

error_taxonomy.transaction_error: solana_sdk::transaction::TransactionError variants include InsufficientFundsForFee, AccountNotFound, BlockhashNotFound, InvalidAccountIndex, ProgramAccountNotFound, DuplicateInstruction, InvalidWritableAccount, and InstructionError(program_idx, InstructionErrorKind) wrapping program-specific failures.
error_taxonomy.instruction_error: InstructionError details cover Custom(u32) for program-defined codes, MissingRequiredSignature, InsufficientFunds, etc.
error_taxonomy.anchor_logs: Parse 'Program log:' lines for anchor error strings and hex-encoded custom errors; map to IDL error enum when available.
error_taxonomy.simulation: RpcResponse err: Some(...) with logs populated—treat as hard failure unless replace_recent_blockhash simulation-only mismatch.

security_notes.key_material: Never log Keypair secret bytes; use env or secret manager; rotate compromised keys immediately.
security_notes.signers: Enumerate all required signers (user, PDAs cannot sign—use program invocations); missing signer yields partial signatures and submission rejection.

program_ids_mainnet_reference.disclaimer: Verify before production; used for ix wiring and ALT static keys.

rpc_simulate_transaction_config.replace_recent_blockhash: When true, RPC substitutes fresh blockhash for simulation—do not confuse simulated success with your message's embedded hash validity.
rpc_simulate_transaction_config.sig_verify: Usually true for honest client checks; false only when measuring with intentionally invalid sig (rare).
rpc_simulate_transaction_config.commitment: Align with preflight_commitment on sendTransaction when debugging mismatches.
rpc_simulate_transaction_config.accounts: RpcSimulateTransactionAccountsConfig: request writable accounts for accurate CU if program branches on account data freshness.

blockhash_cluster_constants.max_hash_age_slots_rule_of_thumb: Blockhashes expire after roughly 150 slots (~60–90s wall depending on cluster; measure locally)—always refetch on retry.
blockhash_cluster_constants.one_slot_ms_rule_of_thumb: ~400ms average; use as staleness heuristic not a consensus guarantee.

compute_budget_sizing.headroom_percent_typical: 10–25% above simulated units_consumed for mainnet variance
compute_budget_sizing.fixed_buffer_units: Add small constant (e.g. 5k–20k CU) for logging-heavy paths
compute_budget_sizing.max_network_cu: Clamped upper bound commonly 1_400_000 CU per transaction—confirm against current cluster limits in Solana release notes.

versioned_transaction_alt_rules.signers_must_be_static: Fee payer and all signers must appear in static account keys, not only in lookup tables.
versioned_transaction_alt_rules.writable_loaded_addresses: Loaded addresses from LUT can be writable if marked so in message; still subject to account locks.
versioned_transaction_alt_rules.lut_activation_delay: After extend/close, respect slot delay before LUT contents are visible to consuming transactions.
versioned_transaction_alt_rules.size_measurement: Serialize VersionedTransaction to Vec<u8> and assert len() <= 1232 before sign; measure early when adding accounts.

priority_fee_notes.micro_lamports_per_cu: set_compute_unit_price argument; total priority ~= micro_lamports_per_cu * units_consumed (see network fee docs for exact billing).
priority_fee_notes.dynamic_fee_apis: Some providers expose getRecentPrioritizationFees—optional input to set_compute_unit_price under congestion.

send_transaction_rpc_params.skip_preflight_default_false: Keep false unless you duplicate full validation locally.
send_transaction_rpc_params.preflight_commitment: Often finalized default on nodes; mismatch with simulate commitment can confuse debugging.
send_transaction_rpc_params.max_retries_param: Some clients expose maxRetries for server-side rebroadcast—understand it does not replace your blockhash refresh logic.

jito_bundle_limits_note.bundle_tx_count: Jito bundles allow multiple transactions in order—max count and size per Block Engine policy; see solana-jito-mev-tips.nodus.json.
jito_bundle_limits_note.double_send_risk: If both Jito and RPC send succeed, you may double-execute unless idempotent or guarded by on-chain nonce/state.

tokio_operational_defaults.spawn_blocking_for_sim: Wrap solana-dex-swap-math heavy paths; limit in-flight blocking tasks with Semaphore.

instruction_error_kinds_reference.note: Names vary slightly by solana_sdk version; map from logs + InstructionError enum.
